$doc: Project-level stack configuration consumed by slowcook (@slowcook-ai/stack-solidity). Tells the harness how to discover and run tests. Only include suites that are actually runnable — slowcook refuses to record an incomplete manifest. (gas_snapshot enables the gas ratchet: brew treats `forge snapshot --check` regressions as a hard signal. Re-baseline with `forge snapshot` when a gas increase is intentional.)
